caption.en: Nothing grew that day. It had grown anyway.
caption.ko: 그날 늘어난 건 없었다. 그런데 늘어 있었다.

en: Skill doesn't arrive on one day.
It just piles up where you sit.

moral.en: In the end, only what piled up stayed.

narration.en: Skill never arrives on a single day. It only piles up where you sit.
narration.ko: 실력은 어느 날 생기지 않는다. 그 자리에 쌓여 있을 뿐이다.
